answer: Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every whisper settlement recomputes the glacier schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
